name: io.github.ni-c/healthchecks-mcp
title: Healthchecks
description: Inspect, create and adjust Healthchecks cron and uptime checks, and read why one failed

environmentVariables.name: HEALTHCHECKS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Project API key, exactly 32 characters, from Project Settings → API Access

environmentVariables.name: HEALTHCHECKS_URL
environmentVariables.description: Site root of a self-hosted instance, e.g. https://hc.example.net (default: https://healthchecks.io)

environmentVariables.name: HEALTHCHECKS_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to register only the read tools (default: false)

environmentVariables.name: HEALTHCHECKS_ALLOW_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names or list_* prefixes to register; 'essential' selects a curated preset (default: all tools)

environmentVariables.name: HEALTHCHECKS_DENY_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names or list_* prefixes to remove from whatever the allow list left

environmentVariables.name: HEALTHCHECKS_INSECURE_TLS
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to accept a self-signed certificate from a self-hosted instance (default: false)
